title: Mpi-Kanban refresh on 1.5.0: state index rebuild, behaviour.md git drift, two unlisted briefings, PowerShell-blind project hooks
description: Refresh audit found the board CLEAN (277 cards, 0 violations) and all 17 validator failures in state/ plus four drift items outside it. Applying: state/index.json rebuilt from disk via validate_board --fix; behaviour.md git section restored from the 1.5.0 template (its surviving bullet BANNED git commit --only, contradicting CLAUDE.md which mandates it); root-cause.md and engine-recipes.md added to the briefing config (CLAUDE.md tells every dispatcher to paste root-cause.md, and /mpi-brief-rule could not resolve it); project PreToolUse hooks widened to Bash|PowerShell (guard-runpod-create was off on Desktop's primary shell, and it guards a route that rents a GPU); profile renamed to Cubric Studio; two index topics added (in-app agent, mascots); four umbrella cards for the uncovered todo clusters.
